summary: Short east kerb stretch by university trees; loading zone signs and homes 20 m across the road.
reasons: Loading zone signs at both ends

best_section.where: East kerb of Meiers Road opposite the houses, under the trees by Cycad building

drivers.seclusion: University buildings and trees on the kerb side; homes 20 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed kerbside lane; room for one van, few cars parked beside it.
drivers.traffic: Campus access road with moderate traffic.
drivers.convention: Only one or two cars parked along this stretch; loading zone signs (Mon-Fri 7am-6pm) both directions.

sun_shade: Mostly shaded by tall trees from the east side.
cannot_judge: Whether the loading zone is enforced overnight
